scope: Private independent extraction from final states and daily summaries for the ten 10,000-member worlds. No original event journals or simulation.

convention.interval: [entry day, exit day), using the horizon end for a person without exit
convention.monthly_roster: Modeled active members on the 12th calendar day of each month, not employment over a payroll period
convention.exit_count_reconciliation: Retirement is separate in source metrics. All other recorded causes reconcile to the combined exits count.
